next_step: Closed - lost to Replicate and internal vendor freeze. Re-engage in 90 days if hiring stabilizes.
notes: Account originally engaged for semantic search + reranking of large news corpus.
Key ask: sub-150ms p99 for short queries, ability to scale to 200 qps during events, predictable per-token cost.
Security: strict KMS + audit retention 5y, data residency in US, SSO via Okta required.
POC scope: 30-day evaluation using dedicated pool on 4xA100 equivalent; test quantized 8-bit models vs float16.
Customer quote (Eng director): 'Redwood performance looked great in microbenchmarks but Replicate's packaged managed models + simpler procurement sealed it.'
Pricing discussion stalled Dec-Jan — procurement pushed for single-vendor small invoice and Replicate offered consolidated pricing + marketplace contract.
Internal change: Eng lead (champion) left Jan 24; successor deprioritized platform selection while cost freeze in finance active.
Security review: Redwood provided SOC2 report and attestation but reviewer flagged key-rotation SLA and audit export format as gaps; Replicate committed on custom KMS integration in writing.
Final status: Legal/Finance preferred Replicate marketplace path. Marked closed-lost 2025-02-20.
Follow-up plan: skip immediate upsell. Ask for product roadmap call in 90 days, monitor hiring (platform lead) and vendor freeze lift.
